farm.name: Farm
farm.description: Works the soil of a plains tile inside your borders, raising what it yields every turn.

mine.name: Mine
mine.description: Cuts into a mountain. The richest improvement in the game, but mountains are scarce.

quarry.name: Quarry
quarry.description: Strips stone from the tunnels. Only pays out below ground.

barracks.name: Barracks
barracks.description: A military district on its own tile. Units can be built here as well as at your city, so your army no longer has to come from one place.
